Owned units name him only as 我皇/我後 (our emperor/sovereign); he is the Xia ruler Helian Bobo, silent subject of the capital panegyric. Personal name is supplied from chapter identity, not from an owned-unit surface.
Alluded to as a founding model; active-date is Western Zhou King Wen, not the Xia capital-building narrative.
Named as an archetypal master craftsman whose skill is invoked for Helian Bobo's builders, not as a living contemporary.
班輸/輸 is the exemplary artisan (Gongshu Ban / Lu Ban). The date is that artisan's Spring-and-Autumn setting; the Xia palace scene is allusive.
Named only in a comparison of palace splendor to Tathagata's pagoda; activity date is the Buddha's own setting.
Recalled for examining his chamber and eliciting poets' praise; date is King Xuan's reign, not the later inscription.
Opening figure of the inscription's mandate hymn; legendary antiquity, not the Xia-Helian present.
Named only as Bobo's high ancestor in a posthumous-honor list; interval is his own Tiefu generation, not the Xia honor date.
Named only as Bobo's great-grandfather in a posthumous-honor list; interval is his own generation, not the Xia honor date.
Named only as Bobo's grandfather in a posthumous-honor list; interval is his own generation, not the Xia honor date.
Father of Bobo; activity dated to the Tiefu chieftainship ending with his death in AD 391, not the later Xia posthumous honors.
Mother of Bobo, of the Fu clan; dated to Weichen's generation, not the Xia posthumous honor.
Recalled for seeing Bobo; dated to Yao Xing's Later Qin reign, not the Jinshu historian's later appraisal.
宋祖 in the appraisal; dated to Liu Yu's own rise and Song founding, not the later historian's voice.
Legendary progenitor named in the eulogy as Bobo's distant ancestor; not dated by the Xia narrative.

translationRepairs: Defeated by Dai King Tuoba Yilu, he withdrew beyond the border.
Defeated by Dai King Yilu, he withdrew beyond the border.
The Chinese names the Dai king only as 猗盧; Tuoba is not in this sentence and the replacement keeps the title and given name.
He was defeated by the Dai king Tuoba Yilu and fled beyond the frontier.
He was defeated by the Dai king Yilu and fled beyond the frontier.
The source has 代王猗盧, with no surname 拓跋; removing Tuoba from the literal line restores the wording of the Chinese.
That same year he campaigned against the three Xianbei tribes led by Xuegan, broke them, and accepted the surrender of many thousands.
That same year he campaigned against the three Xianbei tribes led by Xuegan, broke them, and accepted the surrender of ten thousand and several thousand.
萬數千 is ten thousand plus several thousand, so 'many thousands' understates the figure; 'a myriad and several thousand' is accurate but stilted, so the numeral is given in plain English.
Rutan's officer Helian Nu said, "Bobo commands the wreckage of defeat, a crowd patched together overnight. He has defied heaven and courted ruin, and only by fortune gained a great victory.
Rutan's officer Helian said angrily, "Bobo commands the wreckage of defeat, a crowd patched together overnight. He has defied heaven and courted ruin, and only by fortune gained a great victory.
賀連怒曰 is the officer 賀連 plus 怒曰 'said angrily'; 怒 is the verb of speech, not a given name Nu.

Rutan's general Helian Nu said, "Bobo is leading the remnant of the defeated, a mob hastily gathered together; he has offended the right order and brought disaster on himself, and only by luck has he won a great success.

Rutan's general Helian said angrily, "Bobo is leading the remnant of the defeated, a mob hastily gathered together; he has offended the right order and brought disaster on himself, and only by luck has he won a great success.
The same 賀連怒曰 construction makes 怒 the adverb of speaking, so the literal name Helian Nu is a false segmentation.
Bobo attacked Yao Shoudu at Qingshui. Shoudu fled to Shanggui, and Bobo resettled sixteen thousand six hundred of the local people in Dacheng.
Bobo attacked Yao Shoudu at Qingshui. Shoudu fled to Shanggui, and Bobo resettled sixteen thousand households of the local people in Dacheng.
萬六千家 is sixteen thousand households, so 'six hundred' is invented; the proposal still drops 家 and must keep the household unit.
Bobo again attacked Yao Xing's general Yao Shoudu at Qingshui city; Shoudu fled to Shanggui, and Bobo moved sixteen thousand six hundred of the inhabitants to Dacheng.
Bobo again attacked Yao Xing's general Yao Shoudu at Qingshui city; Shoudu fled to Shanggui, and Bobo moved sixteen thousand households of the inhabitants to Dacheng.
萬六千家 is sixteen thousand households; dropping the invented six hundred is right, but the literal line must still render 家.
Bobo sent General Pingdong Luyiyu to cut him off, seized Yao Xiang, and captured his entire force.
Bobo sent his General Who Pacifies the East, Luyiyu, to cut him off, seized Yao Xiang, and captured his entire force.
平東 is the office General Who Pacifies the East standing before the name 鹿奕於, not a personal name Pingdong.
Bobo sent his general Pingdong Luyiyu to intercept him on the road, captured Xiang, and took all his followers prisoner.
Bobo sent his General Who Pacifies the East, Luyiyu, to intercept him on the road, captured Xiang, and took all his followers prisoner.
平東 is a title, not part of the name, but stacking 'his general, the General Who Pacifies the East Luyiyu' is redundant and needs a comma after the title.
He pushed on against Dang Zhilong at Dongxiang, accepted his surrender, made him Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and resettled more than three thousand of his households at Ercheng.

He pushed on against Yao Xing's general Dang Zhilong at Dongxiang, accepted his surrender, made him Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and resettled more than three thousand of his households at Ercheng.
姚興將党智隆 identifies Dang as Yao Xing's general; restoring that affiliation matches the Chinese and the literal line.
That year he decreed: "My ancestor, moving north from You and Shuo, took the surname Si; the sound differed from China, so he took his mother's surname Liu.
That year he decreed: "My ancestor, migrating north to You and Shuo, took the surname Si; the sound differed from China, so he took his mother's surname Liu.
自北遷幽、朔 is a northward migration into You and Shuofang, not a departure from those regions.
That year he issued a document: "My august ancestor, moving north from You and Shuo, changed his surname to Si; the sound differed from China, and therefore he took his mother's surname Liu.
That year he issued a document: "My august ancestor, migrating north to You and Shuo, changed his surname to Si; the sound differed from China, and therefore he took his mother's surname Liu.
The literal line likewise reversed 自北遷幽、朔; 'migrating north to You and Shuo' restores the direction of the move.

He installed his wife Lady Liang as queen, his son Gui as crown prince, enfeoffed his son Yan as Duke of Pingyang, Chang as Duke of Taiyuan, Lun as Duke of Jiuquan, Ding as Duke of Pingyuan, Man as Duke of Henan, and An as Duke of Zhongshan.

He installed his wife Lady Liang as queen, his son Gui as crown prince, enfeoffed his son Yan as Duke of Yangping, Chang as Duke of Taiyuan, Lun as Duke of Jiuquan, Ding as Duke of Pingyuan, Man as Duke of Henan, and An as Duke of Zhongshan.
陽平公 is Duke of Yangping; Pingyang reverses the characters as if the fief were 平陽.
He made his wife Lady Liang queen, his son Gui crown prince, and enfeoffed Yan, Chang, Lun, Ding, Man, and An as dukes.

He made his wife Lady Liang queen, his son Gui crown prince, and enfeoffed Yan as Duke of Yangping, Chang as Duke of Taiyuan, Lun as Duke of Jiuquan, Ding as Duke of Pingyuan, Man as Duke of Henan, and An as Duke of Zhongshan.
The Chinese lists each son's ducal fief in full; collapsing them to 'as dukes' omits named titles the sentence actually gives.
Bobo attacked Shanggui; in twenty days he took it, killed Hong's Qin Province governor Yao Pingdu and more than five thousand officers and soldiers, destroyed the city, and departed.
Bobo attacked Shanggui; in twenty days he took it, killed Hong's Qin Province governor Yao Pingdu and five thousand officers and soldiers, destroyed the city, and departed.
將士五千人 is an exact five thousand; 'more than' has no 餘 or equivalent in this clause.
He attacked Yinmi and killed Yao Liangzi and more than ten thousand soldiers.
He attacked Yinmi and killed Xing's general Yao Liangzi and more than ten thousand soldiers.
興將姚良子 names Yao Liangzi as Xing's general; the idiomatic line had dropped that affiliation.
He made his son Chang forward general and governor of Yong, garrisoning Yinmi.
He made his son Chang Bearer of the Staff, Forward General, and Governor of Yong Province, garrisoning Yinmi.
The appointment is 使持節、前將軍、雍州刺史; dropping Bearer of the Staff and shortening the governorship omits stated offices.
He made Yan attendant and Tao minister of works, left Yang Gou'er to garrison Anding with five thousand Xianbei.
He made Yan Attendant-in-Ordinary and Tao Master of Writing, left the General Who Garrisons the East, Yang Gou'er, to garrison Anding with five thousand Xianbei.
尚書 is a Master of Writing, not Minister of Works, and 鎮東 is a general's title, but 'Zhen-Dong' is not English; render the title in full.
He made Yan Attendant-in-Ordinary and Tao Minister of Works, left Yang Gou'er of the east to garrison it, and assigned five thousand Xianbei.
He made Yan Attendant-in-Ordinary and Tao Master of Writing, left the General Who Garrisons the East, Yang Gou'er, to garrison it, and assigned five thousand Xianbei.
尚書 is not Minister of Works and 鎮東 is not 'of the east', but the proposed 'Zhen-Dong' still fails to translate the title.
Bobo had Huangfu Hui compose a reply in secret, then dictated it to a clerk before Liu Yu—who marveled at the text.

Bobo ordered his Palace Secretariat Attendant Huangfu Hui to compose a text and memorize it secretly; he summoned Yu's envoy forward, dictated it orally to a clerk to write, sealed it, and returned it to Yu.
召裕使前 summons Liu Yu's envoy, not Yu in person; 裕覽其文而奇之 belongs to the next sentence.

Bobo ordered his Palace Secretariat Attendant Huangfu Hui to compose a text and memorize it secretly; he summoned Yu forward, dictated it orally to his document clerk to write, sealed it, and returned it to Yu.

Bobo ordered his Palace Secretariat Attendant Huangfu Hui to compose a text and memorize it secretly; he summoned Yu's envoy forward, dictated it orally to his document clerk to write, sealed it, and returned it to Yu.
裕使 is Yu's envoy; the original literal 'summoned Yu forward' misreads the object of 召.
Yizhen sent Shen Tianzi against him; Tianzi was beaten back to Liuhui Fort.
Yizhen sent the Dragon-Soaring General Shen Tianzi against him; Tianzi was beaten back to Liuhui Fort.
義真遣龍驤將軍沈田子 states the office; omitting Dragon-Soaring General leaves out a named title.
Yizhen sent the Flying Cavalry General Shen Tianzi to lead the host to meet in battle; he was unsuccessful and withdrew, encamping at Liuhui Fort.
Yizhen sent the Dragon-Soaring General Shen Tianzi to lead the host to meet in battle; he was unsuccessful and withdrew, encamping at Liuhui Fort.
龍驤將軍 is Dragon-Soaring General; Flying Cavalry would be a different title.
Maide captured Fu Hongzhi, Kuai En, and Mao Xiuzhi at Qingni and piled their heads into a mound.
Maide captured the Jin General of Pacifying the North Fu Hongzhi, the Pacification General Kuai En, and Yizhen's Marshal Mao Xiuzhi at Qingni and piled heads into a victory mound.
獲 marks live capture of the three officers, while 積人頭以為京觀 is a mound of the slain, not those captives' heads; the offices are also in the Chinese.
Bobo feasted his officers in Chang'an and told Maide: "Your words bore fruit within a week—no strategy left over.
Bobo feasted his officers in Chang'an and told Maide: "Your words of former days bore fruit after one year's circuit—no strategy left unused.
一周 here is a year's circuit of the earlier counsel (往日之言), not a seven-day week.
Thereupon Bobo held a great feast for officers at Chang'an, raised his cup and said to Wang Maide: "Your words of other days bore fruit within a week—one may call it a plan without leftover strategy.

Thereupon Bobo held a great feast for officers at Chang'an, raised his cup and said to Wang Maide: "Your words of other days bore fruit after one year's circuit—one may call it a plan without leftover strategy.
The same 一周 is an annual circuit, so 'within a week' in the literal speech is a mistranslation.
Helian Chang took Tong Pass, seized Zhu Lingshi and Wang Jing, and sent them to Chang'an.
Helian Chang attacked Lingshi and the Dragon-soaring General Wang Jing at Cao Gong's old rampart on Tong Pass, took it, seized Lingshi and Jing, and sent them to Chang'an.
The Chinese names the attack on 潼關之曹公故壘 and 龍驤將軍王敬; the idiomatic line had collapsed place, title, and the taking of the fort.
Helian Chang attacked Lingshi and the Flying Cavalry General Wang Jing at Cao Gong's old rampart on Tong Pass, took it, seized Lingshi and Jing, and sent them to Chang'an.
Helian Chang attacked Lingshi and the Dragon-soaring General Wang Jing at Cao Gong's old rampart on Tong Pass, took it, seized Lingshi and Jing, and sent them to Chang'an.
龍驤將軍 is Dragon-soaring General, not Flying Cavalry, matching the office given for Wang Jing.

Of old under Potao Tang, number struck adverse fortune; our august ancestor Great Yu with utmost sage bearing met the age of ordering the realm, opened Dragon Gate and faced Yi Que, cleared the three rivers and cut the nine streams, quelled the utmost calamity of the One Origin, and rescued the drowning of the six harmonies—his great achievement matched Heaven and Earth, his divine merit surpassed creation; therefore the two regulators sent blessing, the three spirits joined in praise, he yielded and received the end, and brightly opened the age of Xia.

Of old under Tao Tang, number struck adverse fortune; our august ancestor Great Yu with utmost sage bearing met the age of ordering the realm, opened Dragon Gate and faced Yi Que, cleared the three rivers and cut the nine streams, quelled the utmost calamity of the One Origin, and rescued the drowning of the six harmonies—his great achievement matched Heaven and Earth, his divine merit surpassed creation; therefore the two regulators sent blessing, the three spirits joined in praise, he yielded and received the end, and brightly opened the age of Xia.
昔在陶唐 is Yao's designation Tao Tang; Potao Tang wrongly fuses 昔 with 陶唐.
For two thousand years, though dynasties rose at Xiao and Han and Qin and Yong became battlegrounds, the north stayed calm and the lord kept his throne.

For more than two thousand years, though the three successions in turn ruled at Xiao and Hangu, the five virtues changed fortune at Yi and Luo, Qin and Yong became battlegrounds, and Zhou and Yu arenas of strife, You and Shuo stayed calm and the lord kept constant honor.
崤、函 is the Xiao–Hangu pair, not Han, and 二千餘載 is more than two thousand years, but the proposed line still drops 五德革運于伊、洛 and 周、豫為爭奪之藪.
The dragon rose in northern Beijing, then righteous wind covered the nine districts;
The dragon rose in the northern capital, then righteous wind covered the nine districts;
北京 in this panegyric is the northern capital, not the later city name Beijing.
He summoned master craftsmen, gathered timber and stone from every quarter, and personally directed wonder—building detached palaces south and north of the main halls.

He summoned the marvelous craftsmen of Wang Er and the subtle artisans of Ban Shu, gathered timber and stone from every quarter, and personally directed wonder—building detached palaces south of the open chamber and north of Yong'an.
The sentence names 王爾 and 班輸 and sites the halls 露寢之南 and 永安之北; those names and places were omitted.

Thereupon he extended the marvelous craftsmen of Wang Er, commanded the subtle artisans of Ban Chu, sought patterned catalpa in Deng Forest, gathered embroidered stone on Mount Heng; the nine domains offered gold and silver, the eight directions presented rare treasures; he personally wielded wonder, jointly set compass and square, built a detached palace south of the open chamber and raised a separate hall north of Yong'an.

Thereupon he extended the marvelous craftsmen of Wang Er, commanded the subtle artisans of Ban Shu, sought patterned catalpa in Deng Forest, gathered embroidered stone on Mount Heng; the nine domains offered gold and silver, the eight directions presented rare treasures; he personally wielded wonder, jointly set compass and square, built a detached palace south of the open chamber and raised a separate hall north of Yong'an.
班輸 is Ban Shu (Gongshu Ban); Chu misreads 輸.

If one seeks the category by name, traces form to test truth, tests substance to investigate name—form in doubt, wonder emerges—though the treasure pagoda of Tathagata and Vajra, the divine palace of Shakra and Trayastrimsa, they are not yet enough to compare its beauty when ornamented.

If one seeks the category by name, traces form to test truth, tests substance to investigate name—form in doubt, wonder emerges—though the treasure pagoda of Tathagata and Sumeru, the divine palace of Shakra and Trayastrimsa, they are not yet enough to compare its beauty when ornamented.
須彌 is Mount Sumeru, not Vajra, in the comparison 如來、須彌之寶塔.
He summoned master builders and founded the imperial capital.
He summoned Shu and Er and founded the imperial capital.
乃延輸、爾 names the exemplary artisans Shu and Er; 'master builders' erases those names.
This was the text of Director of the Masters of Writing Hu Yizhou.
This was the text of the Director of the Palace Library Hu Yizhou.
秘書監 is Director of the Palace Library, not Director of the Masters of Writing (尚書).
This was the text of the Director of the Masters of Writing Hu Yizhou.
This was the text of the Director of the Palace Library Hu Yizhou.
The literal line repeats the same mistranslation of 秘書監 as the Masters of Writing.
